𝗕𝗿𝗶𝗱𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗔𝗰𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗰 𝗘𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲: 𝗣𝗔𝗖𝗧 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 𝗮𝘁 𝗡𝗶𝗿𝗺𝗮 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆'𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗟𝗮𝘄

Amit Patel & Associates is proud to share that our Founder and Managing Partner, Mr. Amit Patel, was part of the Distinguished Panel for the Professional and Academic Competency Test (PACT) 2026, held on 3rd October 2026 at the Institute of Law, Nirma University.

PACT is the flagship initiative of the Campus Recruitment Cell. It is an interview-based assessment that gives students an opportunity to demonstrate their academic understanding, legal aptitude, communication skills and professional competence. As part of the Cell's academic and professional development initiatives, it aims to foster a culture of professional preparedness, substantive legal knowledge and excellence among law students.

Initiatives of this kind matter because the legal profession asks for more than theoretical knowledge. Clients, courts and colleagues expect clarity of thought, sound application of the law, effective communication and professional discipline. A structured interaction with practising professionals gives students a realistic picture of these expectations, and an early chance to refine their approach before they enter the profession.

During the event, Mr. Patel interacted with the students, understood how they approach legal questions, and shared practical feedback drawn from his experience in practice. The interactions across diverse areas of law, including emerging areas of professional interest, were encouraging, and the students' preparation and enthusiasm reflect well on the Institute.

We extend our sincere thanks to the Institute of Law, Nirma University, Ahmedabad University for inviting our Founder and Managing Partner to be part of this platform. We are also grateful to Prof. (Dr.) Madhuri Parikh, Director, Institute of Law, for her continued support of initiatives that connect legal education with the realities of professional practice.
To the students: build strong fundamentals, communicate with confidence, stay curious, and treat every opportunity to learn from the profession as an investment in your career. The profession needs capable, ethical and well-prepared lawyers, and you are on the right path.

At Amit Patel & Associates, we remain committed to supporting meaningful engagement between academia and the legal profession, and we look forward to many more such opportunities.

comment: One practical challenge is ensuring assessments reward legal reasoning over rehearsed answers. The ability to identify uncertainty, ask the right questions and explain a defensible position is what practice ultimately demands.
